Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a refined native mobile smart-home settings UI for Super LOOI, SIMPLIFIED CHINESE. Single flat front-on LANDSCAPE PHONE SCREEN, 2.16:1 aspect ratio, 844 x 390 logical points rendered crisply at high resolution. Full bleed app screenshot, no device frame, no surrounding canvas. Restrained charcoal dark theme: background #111214, selected surface #292a2d, fine gray separators, off-white primary text, muted gray secondary text, warm ivory primary button; small green status dots with text. System Chinese sans font. No gradients, no warning banners, no promotional graphics, no nested rounded cards. MAIN PURPOSE: Xiaomi has TWO independent authorizations: device control already connected, camera video not yet connected. Show both under ONE Xiaomi provider, not two top-level providers. Do NOT falsely claim both logins are the same identity.
LAYOUT: 72pt wide persistent left app rail with small black LOOI icon with two cream eyes and destinations 模型 / 语音 / 家居 / 底座 / 任务 / 设置. 家居 selected gray rounded background. Header height 50pt above remaining content: 我的设备 · 6 then 服务绑定 selected in a compact rounded neutral pill, 返回 at far right. No extra Super LOOI text header. Below header a 180pt-wide service list pane with one hairline divider on the right. Section title 家居服务. Selected row: green Xiaomi icon, 米家直连, TWO clear small status lines 控制已连接 (tiny green dot), 视频未连接 (tiny neutral gray dot). Second row blue Home Assistant icon, Home Assistant, subtitle 已连接 · 2 台设备. Bottom quiet separated item 离线演示 / 未启用. Selection must be fill only, not leading bars.
RIGHT MAIN DETAIL: spacious full height panel with no enclosing card. Top compact heading 米家直连 and small 更多 ··· action at right. One compact row 服务地区 with right value 中国大陆 ⌄. Two vertically stacked compact CAPABILITY sections separated by horizontal hairlines, each NOT nested card:
Section 1: small neutral toggle/device icon then bold 设备控制, small green dot 已连接 to its right. Secondary short line 同步设备并控制开关、灯光等. On far right a default subtle outlined 同步设备 button 44pt tall. Beneath within same section one compact setting row 显示米家设备 with an ON switch at far right; avoid extra explanatory sentence.
Section 2: small neutral camera icon then bold 摄像头视频, small neutral dot 未连接 to its right. Secondary line 额外登录，用于查看实时画面. On far right ONE warm ivory primary 连接视频… button 44pt tall. Under this section one quiet short hint 使用摄像头所属的米家账号登录. This is NOT an error, do not use yellow or red.
Everything fits short landscape phone height with clear primary action at video connection. Shorter section headers and clean baseline alignment, sensible 12/16/24pt spacing, text comfortable at 13-16pt logical sizes. Video '未连接' means not authorized, NOT stream failure. No fake camera count before video login. No raw tokens, no protocol names, no port numbers. Do not render the login modal, just this provider settings screen. Visually show one provider with two independently connectable capabilities.

Use case: text-localization. Edit this exact UI screenshot. Change ONLY the setting row label 显示米家设备 to 启用设备控制, using exactly the same font, size, position, off-white color and alignment. This toggle actually enables/disables the device-control source, not just visual visibility. Preserve all other pixels, layout, dimensions, icons, service labels, independent green control connection status and gray video not connected status, switches, primary video connection button, background and whitespace. Do not redesign or add anything. Simplified Chinese must be crisp.
